content: When threading a new dimension (tenancy, auth, request scope) through a system and declaring some helper "out of scope" for the change, enumerate EVERY caller of that helper — not just the obvious subsystem. A second, non-obvious caller running inside the new scope will silently leak across the boundary.
context: T-044 multi-tenancy plan review (round 1) caught getSourceId() (sync-state.ts) leaking to the flat un-namespaced path: the plan asserted sync-state was "client-local only", but createLesson() (storage.ts) also calls getSourceId() and runs inside a tenant scope via the zug_create_lesson tool. Fix: getSourceId now resolves under getPaths().zugDir.
title: Grep ALL callers before excluding a shared helper from a cross-cutting change
